purpose: Every recurring timer in the portal that can reach Supabase. A new or extra scheduleVisiblePolling/setInterval call fails scripts/budget/edge-budget-model.test.mjs until it is registered here with its cadence and cost, and the Edge budget model is updated if it invokes an Edge Function.

research-portal/src/App.tsx.cadence: readings/valve/device-sync/health every 5 min, sales-support 2 min (admins), tracked settings commands 15 s while pending

research-portal/src/ChamberControlView.t.cadence: gas_mixer_remote_status every 15 s; 15 s session-end check (no request) while a live view is open

research-portal/src/ChamberSchedules.tsx.cadence: chamber_schedule_overview every 5 s while a schedule is enabled or running, else 15 s

research-portal/src/GasMixerNativeContro.cadence: 1 s tick; gas_mixer_native_status every 1 s only while a command awaits receipt, else 5 s

research-portal/src/LightingNativeContro.cadence: 1 s tick; lighting_native_status every 1 s only while a command awaits receipt, else 5 s

research-portal/src/WebsiteAnalyticsTile.cadence: website-analytics every 5 min while the admin home is visible

research-portal/src/analytics/WebsiteAna.cadence: website-analytics report every 5 min while the workspace is visible

research-portal/src/HoldWaterControl.tsx.cadence: 100 ms elapsed-time display while watering, no request

research-portal/src/holdSession.ts.cadence: manual-hold renew every 400 ms while a hold button is pressed (max 15 s)

research-portal/src/product/useNoteOutbo.cadence: 15 s outbox check; requests only while unsent notes exist (backoff to 5 min)
